database.name: SellTech AI Processors
database.enrichmentDecision: Missing technical fields supplemented from user CPU.zip; exact model identity with structural checks; ZIP values are source-reported and not independently verified. Existing values retained; benchmark scores, prices and exact release dates not imported.

rules.nullPolicy: Fields without a concrete value are omitted.
rules.knownAbsencePolicy: Known NOT_APPLICABLE / NOT_SUPPORTED / variant-dependent states are preserved only where they carry recommendation meaning.
rules.unknownPolicy: UNKNOWN or unverified placeholders are not emitted as concrete processor values.
rules.softScoring: Missing SOFT data is excluded from the available score denominator and may reduce confidence.
rules.pricing: No static market price is fabricated; runtime pricing uses only captured offer data when available.
rules.performance: Only captured benchmark/performance values are used; missing performance values are never fabricated or synthesized from clocks, cores, release year, or model naming.
rules.determinism: Same database version, revision-equivalent dataset, and same answers must produce the same database-driven eligibility/ranking, excluding explicitly live runtime market data.
